summary.key_theme: Nvidia 透過持續的策略性投資、強勁的客戶需求以及 AI 生態系統的深化布局，鞏固了其在人工智慧領域的領導地位與長期成長動能。

bullish.title: Nvidia's investments grow to $99 billion as chip giant becomes major backer of AI companies
bullish.reason: Nvidia 持有的權益投資高達 990 億美元，顯示其不僅是晶片供應商，更成為 AI 產業的關鍵資本配置者，透過投資上下游強化生態系。

bullish.title: Why Nvidia's 'defensive move' to acquire Hugging Face is about much more than chips
bullish.reason: 以 129 億美元收購 Hugging Face 具有高度戰略價值，能深化與開發者社群的連結，並保護其開放 AI 生態系統的護城河。

bullish.title: AWS Plans 2 Million More NVIDIA GPUs. Is This Better News for AMZN’s Cloud Growth or NVDA’s Backlog?
bullish.reason: AWS 宣布部署 200 萬顆 Blackwell Ultra 與 Rubin 晶片，直接驗證了 Nvidia 高階 AI 晶片的強勁積壓訂單與市場需求。

bullish.title: Elon Musk Committed SpaceX to Building "Exclusively on Nvidia."
bullish.reason: SpaceX 承諾僅使用 Nvidia 晶片進行基礎設施建設，確保了 Nvidia 在大型客戶端的獨家供應地位，排除了競爭對手。

bullish.title: NVIDIA & 2 Profitable Stocks to Buy in September for Big Upside
bullish.reason: 高達 63.7% 的淨利率與 93.3% 的預期獲利成長，顯示 Nvidia 在營運效率與成長性上均處於市場頂尖水準。

bullish.title: Nvidia Gains 2% as RTX Spark Pushes AI Beyond the Cloud
bullish.reason: RTX Spark 技術將 AI 推向個人電腦與邊緣運算，為 Nvidia 開闢了除資料中心以外的全新營收成長路徑。

bullish.title: Prediction: Vera Rubin Is About to Become a $20 Billion Windfall for Nvidia by Next Quarter
bullish.reason: 市場預期 Vera Rubin 晶片將在下一季貢獻 200 億美元營收，支撐公司整體 1,080 億美元的營收指引。

bullish.title: Jensen Huang Said This Word Exactly 1 Time During Nvidia's Earnings Call, and That Was Enough to Put Artificial Intelligence (AI) Bubble Fears to Rest
bullish.reason: 執行長黃仁勳的談話成功消除了市場對於 AI 基礎設施投資不可持續的泡沫擔憂，有助於穩定投資人信心。

neutral.title: S&P 500, Dow End Lower As Blowout Jobs Report Fans Rate Hike Fears, While Chipmaker Strength Aids Nasdaq
neutral.reason: 雖然整體大盤因就業報告引發升息擔憂而下跌，但 Nvidia 等晶片股表現相對強勢，顯示其具備抗跌性。

neutral.title: Coatue Opened Positions in Intel and Cerebras. Is the AI Chip Trade Broadening Beyond NVIDIA?
neutral.reason: 投資機構開始布局 Intel 與 Cerebras，引發市場討論 AI 晶片投資是否會分散，但目前對 Nvidia 的市占率尚未構成實質威脅。
